1.19
- fixed bug in OP9
- switched to own weather solar calculator instead of forecast.solar
1.18
- various improvements incuding solarbalance if profitable
- fix double batt_discharge_efficiency
1.17
- moved reformat array into OP6
- adapted OP6 ti look at all future slots instead of just today
- adapted OP6 to include solarbalance if the schedule itself is not reaching 100%
1.16
- fixed new OP3
1.15
- adopt Rob's new OP function and use solarbalance when rates are cheap instead of not expensive
- 
1.14
- use shared mqtt functions by setting msg.root_topic
- change from idle to solarbalance if there is solar and rates are either cheap or normal
- at midnight, cut over scheme, rather than recalculate, and send to domo

1.13
Various optimisations including:
- only get rates at 15:01 if not available
- create rates array indexed by 15m time slots as key

1.12
Prepared for Tibber Quarter prices

1.11
- Also make today/tomorrow charge scheme when it is not interested (all 'idle')

1.10
- Better compatible with HASS

1.09
- Using forcast.solar for today/tomorrow forecast
- Simplified flow

1.08
- setting milliseconds in today date check to 0
- 
1.07
- Optimized OptimusPrime (only use max. to charge hour count in highPrices block)
